self_assessment: Ported the already-correct add_db_name/expand_record implementations from openlibrary/catalog/utils into merge_marc.py (re-exporting from utils to avoid duplication), added a new threshold_match(e1, e2, threshold, debug) that expands raw records internally and runs the existing level1/level2 cascade, and made editions_match(rec, existing, threshold=875, debug=False) delegate to it so a raw, non-pre-expanded rec is accepted while staying backward compatible with already-expanded inputs (detected via absence of a 'title' key) and with attempt_merge; all 64 existing tests in test_merge_marc.py and test_utils.py pass (1 pre-existing xfail unaffected), plus manual checks for the 875/515 thresholds, None/empty authors, and publish_country validity, but I could not run add_book/tests/test_match.py (which exercises the add_book.match wrapper against a mock_site Thing) because that pulls in a much heavier dependency chain (eventer, full DB mocks) not feasible to install quickly, so that path is unverified beyond code review confirming it is unaffected since add_book/match.py itself was left untouched.
